title: Supported structure maps are eventually killed by Koszul augmentations
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], r a natural number, and f:Fin(r)→A. Let U be the union of the principal opens D(f_i). Use the shared derived category of modules on X and its localized site over U [def-pc-derived-category]. Let E belong to D_QCoh(O_X), with zero restriction to U. For the Koszul tail power system [def-sc-koszul-open-system], write I_e, O and u_e:I_e→O for its derived tail, structure object and augmentation, where index e means exponent e+1. For every integer n and every morphism φ:O[n]→E, there exists a natural number e for which u_e[n] followed by φ is zero. No orthogonality, regularity, nonzero-ring or nonempty-family hypothesis is made.

source.place: Equation 36.9.4.1 (Tag 08DC), Proposition 36.9.5 (Tag 08DD), and Lemma 36.15.2 (Tag 09IR), supported-object reduction

proof.text: Move source shift n to target shift -n using the shift adjunction. Homology shift isomorphisms preserve quasi-coherence, and restriction commutes with shift, preserving the zero restriction. Represent the shifted target by a complex in the given localization, choose standard localizations, and transfer quasi-coherence and zero restriction via homology and mapDerivedCategoryFactors isomorphisms and uniqueness of localization. Compose restriction with the exact equivalence Scheme.Modules.overEquiv. Apply lem-sc-affine-perfect-open-represent-cohomology: its colimit point is a Hom set into the zero restricted target and is therefore a singleton. Transport the Hom diagram and its colimit via Localization.homEquiv, whose composition and map laws explicitly identify transitions. Use Functor.CoconeTypes to transport across different morphism universes, replacing the singleton point by PUnit in the requested universe. Consequently the index-zero element u_0 composed with the shifted map and the zero element have the same image in this colimit; no explicit comparison formula is needed.

Apply Mathlib Types.FilteredColimit.isColimit_eq_iff' to obtain equality at a later index b. Diagram transitions are precomposition with koszulOpenMap and preserve zero. Transfer the augmentation compatibility clause of lem-sc-affine-perfect-open-represent-cohomology from standard localization back to the chosen one by the uniqueness equivalence and its natural isomorphism. This identifies the transitioned composite with u_b followed by the shifted map, so it is zero. Naturality and injectivity of the shift adjunction Hom equivalence move the shift back to the source. No step assumes a nonempty family, nonzero ring, regularity, or nonvanishing entries.

from.place: Perfect-generation induction: supported affine object; filtered-colimit comparison step proving that maps from structure shifts are eventually killed by Koszul augmentations.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_supported_augmentation_eventually_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : U = ⨆ i : Fin r, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hres : IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E.obj))
    (n : ℤ) (φ : (koszulOpenStructure A)⟦n⟧ ⟶ E.obj) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, (koszulOpenUnit A r f e)⟦n⟧' ≫ φ = 0
